👋 Hi, I’m Niklas, # an AI Solutions Engineer based in Munich with a passion for building intelligent systems end-to-end and at scale.
💼 Career # Currently, I’m part of the Solution Factory team of Aleph Alpha, contributing to sovereign AI built from the heart of Europe 🇪🇺🇩🇪
Before that, I worked as an AI Engineer at one of the biggest streaming & entertainment players in the German-speaking region of Europe, developing and scaling a langgraph-based RAG agent for content discovery serving millions of users.
🤖 Techstack # Frameworks
Infrastructure
Data Science
Tools
🎓 Academia # I studied a combination of Quantitative Finance & Computer Science at the Technical University of Munich.
My master’s thesis leveraged different traditional Machine & Deep Learning models to forecast Corporate Earnings up to three years into the future, derive firms’ implied cost of capital estimates from these forecasts, and finally formulate investment strategies that outperformed those based on financial analysts’ earnings estimates.
🚀 What fascinates me # Tech, computers and robots have fascinated me since my childhood. I am therefore ecstatic to be living through the current era and witnessing how humanity starts developing towards my wildest Sci-Fi dreams - with humanoid (consumer) robots and ever-improving LLMs that make AI just feel natural and magical.
🎲 Beyond the code # Outside of work and coding projects, I like to immerse myself in creative hobbies such as video- & retrogames, tabletop role-playing games like Dungeons & Dragons, but also playing electric guitar and doing some strength training.
Peripherals-wise, I’m currently rocking the ZSA Moonlander as my ergonomic split keyboard of choice.
📬 Let’s connect # If you like what I do, don’t be a stranger and feel free to reach out!
